record.reason: Primary arXiv HTML, sections 1 and 4: a fully on-device PII substitution pipeline combines a 1.5B MoE classifier, 1-bit 1.7B SLM, and rule-based substitutions; on x86-64 CPU with 31 GB RAM, hybrid mode reports 41.2 s average latency versus 1.6–1.7 s for non-generative alternatives. Locale-conditioned rotating examples address demonstration regurgitation. The target is privacy substitution and latency is high; no general LLM efficiency improvement is claimed. Weak on-device SLM deployment adjacency only.
record.title: Locale-Conditioned Few-Shot Prompting Mitigates Demonstration Regurgitation in On-Device PII Substitution with Small Language Models
